decision: Patrick, 21 October 2026, report page q-613-forge-recipes, A: re-cost only the outliers to the typical ratio, in a generated plugin built on One and shipped as a release.
readFrom: game/data/recipes.json: the smith rows at the forge and the Skyforge that the server is asked about, every input priced at the worth of the record a recipe makes it as

rule.how: ratio = worth x makes / what the inputs are worth. A row under low or at high and over has every input count multiplied by the one factor that brings it to target, rounded, never under one. A row already listed keeps the original inputs it was first measured with.

unreachable.name: Pickaxe
unreachable.why: every input is already at the count the rule rounds to (one each at the least), so only the record's worth could bring it to the band, and that is not a recipe change
